title: Presentation of the fppf quotient stack of a scheme groupoid
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $U,R$ be schemes over $S$ with $S$-maps $s,t:R\to U$ and scheme maps $e:U\to R$, $i:R\to R$, $c:R\times_{s,U,t}R\to R$ satisfying [def-a1-scheme-groupoid-laws]. Let $F$ be a category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ and $a:h_U\to F$ a functor over this base, using [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. An fppf quotient presentation consists of the following data and properties. The category $F$ is an fppf stack in the sense of [def-sfb-fppf-stackification]: fibred in groupoids, with effective descent on every covering sieve for the big fppf topology [def-pc-fppf-site]. There is a vertical natural isomorphism $\eta:a\circ h_s\Rightarrow a\circ h_t$. For every test scheme $T/S$, $x,y\in U(T)$, the arrow map induced by $\eta$ is a bijection from $\{r\in R(T):s(r)=x,\ t(r)=y\}$ to the vertical arrows $a(x)\to a(y)$ of $F$. For every object $z$ of $F$ above $T$, there is an fppf covering sieve $V$ of $T$ such that, for each $f:T'\to T$ in $V$, there is $x\in U(T')$ and an arrow $a(x)\to z$ above $f$. Finally, if $r:x\to y$ and $q:y\to z$ are composable scheme-groupoid arrows, their images satisfy $\eta(r)\,;\,\eta(q)=\eta(c(q,r))$, with endpoint equalities transported. The isomorphism $\eta$ is part of the data; all naturality, original arrows and composition are retained. This is a presentation of $[U/R]$, the fppf stackification, up to equivalence over $\mathit{Sch}/S$.
